title: MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini measured — 10 scenes, 400 samples and paired RADAR/LiDAR range counts
dataset: MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini, official mini distribution downloaded August 2026
sensor_configuration: Dataset inventory includes 6 Continental ARS 548 RDI 4D RADAR, 6 LiDAR and 4 camera channels; point measurements use RADAR_LEFT_FRONT and LIDAR_TOP_FRONT only
annotation_schema: TruckScenes v1.2 nuScenes-derived oriented 3D bounding boxes; 27 category definitions; tracked instance tokens; mini metadata contains 25,750 sample-annotation records
split: v1.2-mini, all metadata records plus the first annotated sample from each of 10 scenes for point measurements
conditions: Selected scenes include clear, overcast, rain and snow; city, highway and terminal; day, evening, dark and twilight tags

environment.hardware: Apple Silicon MacBook Air; CPU execution; no CUDA used

measurements.name: RADAR points
measurements.scope: RADAR_LEFT_FRONT, first annotated sample from each of 10 scenes

measurements.name: LiDAR points
measurements.scope: LIDAR_TOP_FRONT, first annotated sample from each of 10 scenes

measurements.name: RADAR points at 150 m or greater
measurements.scope: RADAR_LEFT_FRONT, first annotated sample from each of 10 scenes

measurements.name: RADAR share at 150 m or greater

notes: This is dataset characterisation, not detector evaluation. The point totals cover one sample per scene and must not be presented as a full-dataset density benchmark. Point presence beyond 150 m does not demonstrate reliable object detection at that range.
